reduce.$description: Honor Reduce Motion: no entrance/sidebar collapse animation; badges, banners, and focus appear instantly. Image viewer zoom is stepped (no continuous scale spring); open/close instant under reduce-motion.

min.$description: US-43 view-only zoom minimum (100%). Reset to this on every viewer open.

max.$description: US-43 view-only zoom maximum (300%). Not a crop/edit studio.

step.$description: US-43 zoom button step (50%). Pinch may interpolate between steps on mobile Should; buttons always snap to step grid.

default.$description: US-43 initial zoom each time the viewer opens for a side.
